message.content:
Yes—you can file a noise complaint with the City of Atlanta. Noise violations are handled by the city’s **Code Enforcement** and **Police Department** offices, and you have several convenient ways to report them: | How to File | What You’ll Need | Where to Go | |-------------|------------------|-------------| | **Online (311 portal)** | • Your name & contact info
• Date & time of the disturbance
• Description of the noise (e.g., loud music, construction, barking dogs)
• Location (street address or intersection) | Visit the City of Atlanta 311 website:
or use the mobile app “Atlanta 311.” | | **Phone (311)** | Same information as above | Call 311 (or 404‑656‑3111 if you’re outside the city). The operator will route your call to the appropriate department. | | **Email** | Same information as above | Send an email to **noise@atlantaga.gov**. Include a clear subject line such as “Noise Complaint – [Street] – [Date].” | | **In person** | Same information as above | Visit the nearest Police Department precinct or the City Hall Code Enforcement office. The address is 55 Martin Luther King Jr. Drive, Atlanta, GA 30303. | | **Mobile app (Atlanta 311)** | Same information as above | Download the “Atlanta 311” app from the App Store or Google Play and submit a noise complaint. | ### Quick Reference - **City of Atlanta 311**: https://www.atlantaga.gov/311 - **Atlanta Police Department – Noise & Traffic**: https://www.atlantaga.gov/government/departments/department-of-public-safety/police/traffic-and-noise-ordinance - **Noise Ordinance (City Code)**: The city’s noise ordinance (Chapter 12, Section 12-2) prohibits “excessive or unreasonable noise” during certain hours (typically 10 p.m.–7 a.m. on weekdays and 11 p.m.–7 a.m. on weekends). You can view the full text here: https://www.atlantaga.gov/government/departments/department-of-public-safety/police/traffic-and-noise-ordinance ### Tips for a Successful Complaint 1. **Be Specific** – Include exact times, dates, and a description of the noise source. 2. **Provide Evidence** – If possible, attach a short audio clip or a photo of the source (e.g., a construction site). 3. **Follow Up** – After filing, you’ll receive a reference number. Use it to check the status of your complaint on the 311 portal or by calling 311. ### When to Call Police Directly If the noise is accompanied by other illegal activity (e.g., vandalism, drug use) or if you feel unsafe, call 911 or the Atlanta Police Department directly at 404‑656‑3111. --- **Bottom line:** Yes, you can report a noise complaint to the City of Atlanta. Use the 311 system (online, phone, or app), email, or visit in person to file your complaint. The city’s Code Enforcement and Police Department will investigate and take appropriate action.
